name: Check List Membership
summary: Tells you, for each listed lead, whether they're a member of a given static list (up to 300 IDs per call).
whenToUse: Quick yes/no checks: 'is this person on the exclusion list?' or 'did the enrollment actually work?'

path.name: listId
path.label: List ID
path.hint: Find it via Get Static Lists.

query.name: id
query.label: Lead ID(s)
query.hint: Comma-separated lead IDs to check. Max 300 per call.

response.description: One entry per lead ID with their membership status.
